name: bl-tourist-stay-tax
description: Saint-Barthélemy tourist-stay tax reference researched in 2026 using the local Contributions Code, the 2024 amendment and the current collection portal. Covers the five-percent accommodation base, local exemptions, registration before short letting, separate digital and counter filing deadlines, foreign-currency conversion and platform collection. Includes worked examples and identifies conflicting generic poster wording that should not replace the local Code. Applies to the local taxe de séjour only. Complete amendment reconciliation, cancellation and advance-payment cases, penalty procedures, income taxation of rental profits and independent accountant review remain outstanding.
